name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: French goes with none of Boris, Discovery, or Fork.
Anatoly does not belong to the Morning Study Group.
Garry, London, and Fork belong to different players.
Boris and Nadia are in the same study group.
Nadia, Sicilian, and Discovery belong to different players.
London goes with at least one of Garry or Discovery.
At least two members of the Queen's-Pawn Camp are in the Morning Study Group.
